description: Registered dispatch returns data.job_id and data.status=queued before repository preflight. Read service_interface::job_service::get_job by that exact id until terminal: job.result contains the complete original operation result and job.error retains failure information. Direct Python calls keep their full synchronous results. A bounded public descriptor is persisted; loss of the exclusive owner-memory body or an uncertain terminal write requires reconciliation without replay. Ripgrep-backed content search across the platform git worktree, repo-root confined. Returns ranked hits as {path, line, snippet} where each snippet is secret-shape redacted. Denylisted locations (.git/, profile/ secrets, key material, bundled venvs, runtime dirs) are excluded from results, and every returned hit path is re-confirmed inside the repo root. Server bakes the rg flags; the caller passes only a query (regex/text), an optional include path_glob (e.g. '*.py'), and an optional max_results (hard-capped at 200). If ripgrep is not installed the verb fails LOUD — it never silently falls back to a slower scan.
embedding_description: Submit Search Repository to the shared repository worker; retrieve the exact returned job id for its complete original result or error. Full-text / regex code search across the platform repository worktree using ripgrep. Returns ranked file:line:snippet hits with secrets redacted; excludes .git, profile secrets, and vendored venvs. Use to find where a symbol, string, or pattern appears. Fails loud if rg is absent.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Submission: data.job_id and data.status. Terminal job.result: Object with 'query', 'hits' ([{path, line, snippet}] — snippets secret-redacted), 'truncated', 'hit_count'.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Surface the hit paths + line numbers; if 'truncated' is true, note the result cap was reached and suggest a narrower query or path_glob.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Keep the exact job id and retrieve job_service.get_job until terminal before consuming repository fields. Reconcile uncertain effects instead of resubmitting them. Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Running a repo-root-confined ripgrep content search with server-fixed flags over the platform worktree.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: RepoToolError: ripgrep (rg) is not installed, or the search timed out — the verb never silent-falls-back to a slower scan (B-N2). A search that finds nothing returns hit_count=0 (not an error).
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For RepoToolError (rg absent): install ripgrep on the solet host. For a timeout: narrow the query or scope with path_glob. For zero hits: broaden the query or check the path_glob.
